  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

  Rule ID: RS-1.7

  Rule ID: RS-1.8

  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

  Rule ID: RS-1.7

  Rule ID: RS-1.8

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

    Title: Duty of driver to avoid driving while fatigued
    Definition: A person must not drive a fatigue-regulated heavy vehicle on a road while the person is impaired by fatigue.
    Source: HEAVY VEHICLE NATIONAL LAW (ACT) - SECT 228 (1)

  Rule ID: RS-1.2

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.

  Rule ID: RS-1.2

    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4

    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136

    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.

  Rule ID: RS-1.2

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.

  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.

  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4

    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane

  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

  Rule ID: RS-1.2

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6

    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)

Rule Set: Road Rules (ID: RS-1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.

  Rule ID: RS-1.1
    Title: Giving way at a pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver must give way to any pedestrian on or entering a pedestrian crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 81 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.2
    Title: Overtaking or passing a vehicle at a children's crossing or pedestrian crossing
    Definition: A driver approaching a children's crossing, or pedestrian crossing, must not overtake or pass a vehicle that is travelling in the same direction as the driver and is stopping, or has stopped, to give way to a pedestrian at the crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 82
  Rule ID: RS-1.3
    Title: Proceeding through a red traffic light
    Definition: If traffic lights at an intersection or marked foot crossing are showing a red traffic light, a driver must not enter the intersection or marked foot crossing.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 59
  Rule ID: RS-1.4
    Title: Driving on a one-way service road
    Definition: A driver on the part of the road that is a service road must drive in the same direction as a vehicle travelling on the part of the road closest to the service road is required to travel.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 136
  Rule ID: RS-1.5
    Title: Opening doors and getting out of a vehicle etc.
    Definition: A person must not cause a hazard to any person or vehicle by opening a door of a vehicle, leaving a door of a vehicle open, or getting off, or out of, a vehicle.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 269 (3)
  Rule ID: RS-1.6
    Title: Driving within a single marked lane or line of traffic
    Definition: A driver on a multi-lane road must drive so the driver's vehicle is completely in a marked lane
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 146 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.7
    Title: Emergency stopping lane only signs
    Definition: A driver must not drive in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 95 (1)
  Rule ID: RS-1.8
    Title: Stopping in an emergency stopping lane
    Definition: A driver must not stop in an emergency stopping lane.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 178
  Rule ID: RS-1.9
    Title: Parking in parking bays
    Definition: A driver must position the driver's vehicle completely within a single parking bay.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 211 (2)
  Rule ID: RS-1.10
    Title: Obstructing access to and from a footpath, driveway etc.
    Definition: A driver must not stop on a road in a position that obstructs access by vehicles or pedestrians to or from a footpath ramp or a similar way of access to a footpath, or a bicycle path or passageway.
    Source: ROAD SAFETY ROAD RULES 2017 - REG 198 (1)
